newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash maize dips in unenthusiastic trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash maize dips in unenthusiastic trade.

text.p: Argentine maize slipped in slow cash market trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange Thursday as a higher Chicago failed to inflame buyers' spirits, traders said.

Prices paid to farmers for cash April maize lost $1 to $111. Cash soybeans also defied Chicago and rose. Concern over dry weather blighting southern Cordoba helped squeeze May beans $3 higher to $283. April sunflower seed gained $2 to $224 in tight trade as early harvest yields left the market nonplussed. Bahia Blanca spot wheat drooped $5 to $142 as exporters' minds seemed elsewhere on other products.
